ITEM 1 | Orange-red loose grains, fine and slightly glossy with a tomato-like tint, piled in a mound on the left-center of the plate, roughly 9 cm across and 1.5 cm tall, with some darker flecks and a few separate grains scattered at the edge | 150
ITEM 2 | Brown-to-dark-red chunky pieces with a seared, slightly crisp surface and a dense, moist interior, about 4 to 5 cm long and 2 cm thick, arranged in the center-top area and partly under the orange grains | 110
ITEM 3 | Dark brown, glossy, seared pieces with a charred edge and a soft, moist middle, about 4 cm long and 1.5 cm thick, sitting at the right-center of the plate beside the green beans | 70
ITEM 4 | Thin, bright green slender pods with a fresh, slightly glossy surface, some tips trimmed, arranged in a loose pile covering about 8 by 7 cm on the upper right, each pod about 0.5 cm wide and 6 to 8 cm long | 90
ITEM 5 | Light green wilted leafy greens with darker green edges and a moist, limp texture, spread in a thin layer about 6 by 4 cm in the lower-right area under the chickpeas | 40
ITEM 6 | Tan, round, firm chickpeas with a matte, slightly wrinkled surface, scattered densely over the greens in the lower-right area, covering about 6 by 5 cm and about 1 cm tall in patches | 35
ITEM 7 | Thin, pale green herb sprigs and microgreens with delicate stems, scattered lightly over the rice and meat in the center, each sprig about 3 to 4 cm long and sparse in coverage | 5
ITEM 8 | Small bright red pepper pieces, glossy with a smooth skin, about 1.5 cm across, sitting on the left-center mound of orange grains | 5
